text.p: Heliopolis Housing and Development made net after-tax profits of 57.7 million pounds ($17.0 million) in the first seven months of the financial year 1996/7, the chairman and managing director said. The year began on July 1.
The result compares with 38.823 million in the first six months and 61.3 million in the whole of 1995/6.

Managing director Fadel el-Shehawi, quoted in the government newspaper al-Gomhuria on Wednesday, also said that the state would privatise a further five percent of the equity in the real estate company soon. He gave no other details of the sale.
The state has so far sold 27 percent of the company, including 10 percent to the employees' association, he added.
